objective: Identify which public and native sources can actually answer the preregistered clean-G3 question without hindsight, identity or entity leakage.
primary_question: Does point-in-time, entity-adjusted wallet intelligence add incremental sellable 5x/10x edge above G2 capital-path and microstructure?
non_negotiable_rules: A source-captured smart-wallet label is not equivalent to reconstructed AS-OF wallet quality.
Current wallet PnL or current labels may not be backfilled into historical candidate rows.
Address count is not economic-entity count.
A wallet event must be self-initiated trade evidence before attribution; routers, pools, transfers, dust and seeded activity are excluded.
Theoretical peak return is not a sellable outcome.
No historical result changes BUY_NOW or production thresholds without prospective shadow validation.

sources.reason: The completed v1.2 audit found zero current-token trade rows joining at or before the canonical earliest candidate snapshot. A clean pre-capture buyer graph could not be reconstructed. Source-captured smart-wallet fields remain hypothesis-only.
sources.forbidden_inference: Do not claim reconstructed AS-OF wallet edge from this release.

sources.reason: It provides genuine first-buyer/co-entry structure and contamination controls, but the published result is downstream buyer-flow, not sellable economic return or realizable MFE.
sources.key_research_fact: The revised matched estimate reports +16.1% non-cohort first-30m buyer-count lift while the +6.3% SOL-inflow estimate is not distinguishable from zero at 95% confidence.
sources.next_join_needed: Attach point-in-time sellable return / liquidity survival outcomes without contaminating the cohort definition.

sources.reason: The published decoded per-trade chain files cover an earlier period and have zero-mint intersection with the 85,442 capture mints. The dataset is nevertheless unusually strong for proving whether a field was actually derivable at decision time.
critical_leakage_findings: reach/X fields are not derivable at first sighting in the release and must be excluded from admissible features
negative first-sighting ages exist and require a conservative observer-time bound
curve-progress proxies are explicitly banned because they can mechanically encode the lifecycle outcome
sources.forbidden_inference: Do not treat graduation/path_completed as sellable 5x/10x alpha.

sources.source: Chain of Title frozen public deposit
sources.reason: Excellent for separating apparently independent addresses from creator/funder/operator structures and for provenance, but not by itself a mature wallet-skill return ledger.
sources.license_boundary: Use the frozen public CC0 deposit for bulk historical research. Do not assume current live API data inherits that license or work around current quotas.

sources.source: Pump.fun native create/trade/completion events via pinned event adapter
sources.reason: Native events can establish who actually bought the current token and when. Clean G3 still requires a separate AS-OF ledger of each wallet's prior matured outcomes and entity/funder relationships.
sources.hard_rule: Completion/migration is lifecycle state, never profitability. Quote asset cannot be assumed to be SOL.
Final peak is not realizable return; Git-history interval timing is coarse and must not be represented as minute-precise chain timing.

sources.license_boundary: Public release is CC BY-NC 4.0; commercial reuse requires separate permission.

execute_now: Run an independent point-in-time G2 vs source-captured-G3 secondary ablation on Trenches using the published forward split.
Freeze a Solana/pump.fun regime profile from only point-in-time and venue-native evidence.
Probe RED-COHORT for joinable first-buyer/cohort identifiers and outcome-compatible fields.
Use Chain of Title only as creator/funder/entity adjustment, not as wallet-profitability truth.
Prepare prospective native Pump buyer-graph capture so the final clean-G3 test no longer depends on mutable third-party wallet labels.
do_not_do: Do not tune global smart-wallet thresholds.
Do not import Solana thresholds to Robinhood, BNB, Base or Monad.
Do not promote graduation predictors into BUY_NOW.
Do not collapse all wallet roles into one global smart score.
